description: Invite people into a room, as the account: each gets an in-app invitation and a push ("<your name> invited you"), open for 7 days. Only people from list_invitable_people can be invited (someone the account shares a private room with); any other id fails the whole call with 422. A password-protected room or the personal room takes invitations from its owner only. Inviting someone already invited, or already a member, sends nothing. Answers 201 with sent: how many invitations went out.

items.description: A person's user_id, as list_room_members and list_invitable_people return it.
